/bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- app.py && ./run_python -c 'import tempfile, pathlib, threading; from app import Queue
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=pathlib.Path(d)/\"q.db\"; q=Queue(p); q.put(\"only\", {\"ok\": True}); barrier=threading.Barrier(3); out=[]; lock=threading.Lock()
 def take(name):
  other=Queue(p); barrier.wait(); result=other.claim(name, 0, 5)
  with lock: out.append(result)
 ts=[threading.Thread(target=take,args=(str(i),)) for i in range(2)]
 for t in ts: t.start()
 barrier.wait()
 for t in ts: t.join()
 assert sum(x is not None for x in out)==1, out
print(\"concurrent claim check passed\")'"
